name: Solis Ra'ariki
source:
The sun of a beautiful, prosperous galaxy, Lord Solis takes much pride in his work as a celestial... so much so that he can be unapproachable.

Can the flames of this sun be calmed enough to smell the roses?

[From [url=https://chouette.itch.io/celestia]itch.io[/url]]
